'''2008 Worlds Team Ian Westergaard LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ian Westergaard]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Header inventory had Dan Westergaard DS ACE!!; full sheet is Light We'll Handle This. Player Ian Westergaard from header crop. Abbreviations expanded best-effort.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ian Westergaard]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / Mind What You Have Learned|We'll Handle This]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
